FBX fixtures from https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/v0.23.0/data
Original bytes, under ufbx's MIT/Unlicense terms in LICENSE-ufbx.txt.

blender_279_default_6100_ascii.fbx: old ASCII FBX, constant animation channels,
no explicit units (FBX centimetre default).
blender_279_default_7400_binary.fbx: binary FBX, metre-sized default cube.
blender_293_embedded_textures_7400_binary.fbx: binary FBX with embedded colour,
roughness and emission images.
